answer: Each agent bonds stake to a Semaphore identity and evaluates an epoch-specific polynomial whose committed shares support RLN proofs. The proof binds each message to a rate-limit nullifier; reusing it within the epoch exposes distinct Shamir shares, allowing recovery of the private key and linking the duplicate messages. A verifier can then trigger immediate on-chain slashing of the bond, making Sybil identities costly to maintain. The reef, thread, and copper labels are illustrative, not protocol inputs.
